{{Top|leg}}
A '''crew chief''' was a soldier who served as chief of a maintenance crew, either via hull-intergrity of various vessels, or otherwise a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] ground maintenance personnel.

[[Soskar Renn]], a member of a [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] crew operating during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], held the rank of Crew Chief within the organization.<ref name="Scavenger">{{WEGCite|story=Scavenger Hunt (scenario)|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}</ref>
